value.syntax: # [doc = " Per-stream prefix properties for the calligraphic mode."] # [derive (Debug , Default , Clone)] pub struct StreamProps { # [doc = " Prefix for the first line of each wrapped block on stdout."] pub line1_prefix_stdout : String , # [doc = " Prefix for continuation lines on stdout."] pub wrap_prefix_stdout : String , # [doc = " Prefix for the first line of each wrapped block on stderr."] pub line1_prefix_stderr : String , # [doc = " Prefix for continuation lines on stderr."] pub wrap_prefix_stderr : String , }
